Unlike the crowded Oil & Gas leader or crowded Tech, Banks offer trend continuation without a crowding cap. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, so staying power is the only leg with a real edge — and Banks are the scorable theme where that trend condition is cleanest.
